tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find hair salons, barbershops, nail salons, brow and lash studios and beauty clinics that take online bookings through Timio, in Brazil, Ireland, the United States and Spain. Search by city or neighborhood, by the business name, or by service (for example 'gel nails', 'corte masculino', 'manicura').

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List the services a business offers for online booking, with duration and price when the business shows prices, plus its professionals, address and booking link.

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: Free start times for one service, in the business's local time zone, for the next days. Use the service id from get_services. Optionally pick a professional and a start date. Times change as people book; the booking link shows the current times.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Booking page link for a business, with the service, professional, date and time already chosen when given. The client confirms name and phone on that page; nothing is booked until they do.
